paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 values for different components of a conversation recommendation system. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", in that order, with no apparent scale or sorting. The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 values, labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.25, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.05. The chart features four bars, each with a distinct color: the "Ours" bar is orange and has a value of approximately 0.21, the "- critiquing" bar is blue and has a value of around 0.19, the "- ranking" bar is also blue and has a value of about 0.11, and the "- scoring" bar is blue and has a value of approximately 0.06. There is no stacking or grouping of bars, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and height.
